reviews.text:
August 27, 2026: I can't thank this team of professionals enough. Our pets couldn't be in better hands 💯🙏🏻❤️

Great team of professionals, Django couldn't be in better hands. Thank you guys!!!💯
We were served by two super friendly women and it's clear they really care about animals.

The best veterinary clinic I've ever been to because all the staff are super friendly, kind, and attentive to the dogs and cats!
I have to travel from the north of Madrid, but it's totally worth it because the peace of mind and security I have with Héctor is priceless!
My Chihuahua, Milka, is very well cared for, and for me, that's the most important thing. They're also open on Saturdays, which is a big help if you need anything. They have X-rays to check if anything is wrong with your pet, and they do the tests so well that my dog ​​doesn't even feel the injections, whereas at other places she cried every time because of the pain!
200% recommended!!! ❤️
Thank you for your service and welcome 🤗 …
I took my dog ​​to get his teeth cleaned, and I loved the incredibly friendly and caring service. I'll definitely be back.
My cat Luna had surgery here and everything went perfectly from the start. They are super kind to you, especially considering how nervous I was.

I had to go to the vet urgently because my dog ​​was having an anxiety attack due to the trauma of being abandoned. Even though I didn't have an appointment, they attended to him as quickly as possible, taking the best possible care of him, with excellent treatment and professionalism. 10/10

A terrible experience. The service was poor and the staff's behavior was highly unprofessional. Furthermore, certain situations raised serious suspicions about the relationship between the clinic manager and a cat breeder.

A veterinarian at the clinic issued a health certificate dated October 13th for a cat we bought on the 14th. However, the animal already showed numerous obvious symptoms: eye and nasal discharge, coughing, sneezing, and diarrhea due to an intestinal infection.

As soon as we left the clinic, we contacted them to inform them of the situation. We took the cat back the next day, but to this day, he is still not cured.

In addition, they initially refused to perform a culture and also refused to administer the appropriate medication. I had to insist repeatedly and be firm to get them to treat him properly.

I recommend that other pet owners exercise extreme caution before trusting this place. This review is based on a real and recent experience.

Went there twice and got two separate vets. The first one was very kind and empathetic young woman towards my dog. I was sad that when I returned for a check up she wasn’t there and an older lady checked him out instead. She was very very rude. To me and to my dog.

I made an appointment with the younger woman for the follow up on his condition and the older lady scolded me like a child saying I needed to have an appointment next time AFTER I told her twice that the previous vet had given me an appointment before I left.

She reviewed him with absolutely 0 effort. Also, he’s very friendly and licked her hand while greeting her and she was disgusted by it and told me not to let him do that. (Which some may not mind, but I prefer for the one who can make a difference in my dogs health to at least act like they like animals) As well as quite a few other things but if I include them all this review would be far too long.

She spoke down to me the entire time even though I was nothing but kind to her (looking back I should’ve stood up for myself.)

I never went back after that out of fear of getting an appointment with her instead of the other amazing vet that I felt confident that she would take care of my dog kindly and throughly.

In summary, my first experience was amazing and I left feeling good about my dog’s condition and how we were both treated. Unfortunately it was overshadowed by the rude vet. I would say this place is a hit or miss

As always, I'm delighted with the clinic. I've been taking my 15-year-old podenco and my 10-year-old galga to rehabilitation and laser treatments for some time now, and I couldn't be happier.

Thank you to María, Ángela, Leticia (both of them), Lola, Bea... for taking such good care of us.
I love the team at this veterinary clinic. They are all very kind and friendly with my pet.
Well, since that vet wasn't available, they sent us to the one they have in Bilbao. They saw us shortly after we arrived and everything went very well.
Excellent service, 100% recommended.
Delighted with the way they treat my cats, they are passionate professionals.

We took my 3-month-old kitten to the vet to have his ear checked because he was dizzy and tilting his head to one side. He was diagnosed with otitis externa and given a treatment that's working very well so far. Sara is very good with animals and treats them very kindly. The other people I met there were also careful with the kitten and kind to us.

A TERRIBLE and dangerous experience for my dog.

I took him to the Chueca veterinary clinic, which, along with the Malasaña clinic, belongs to the same owners.
Without running any tests, without an x-ray, and without even properly examining his mouth, they told me he needed urgent surgery to extract several teeth. Without hesitation, they gave me a quote of €300 for the operation, in addition to what I had already paid for the consultation, medication, and blood work.

Something didn't add up, so I sought a second opinion from another veterinarian. The result? No extractions were necessary, just a dental cleaning!

My dog ​​was almost subjected to invasive and unjustified surgery because of a completely erroneous diagnosis!

This isn't a simple mistake; it's a serious lack of professionalism and ethics that could have jeopardized my pet's health.

This clinic CANNOT BE TRUSTED. You can't play with animals' lives like this for money.

If you value your pet's health, stay away from this place!
They're so good that I've been taking my cats there from San Sebastián for years. Their professionalism and service are unbeatable.
They LOVE my dog ​​at this place. Excellent service and a very professional team in pet care.

A LINE-OFF WITHOUT ANY JOB.

I've been taking my dog ​​there for a year and a half, and I'm already feeling quite unhappy because every time I go, there are new staff members I don't know. It's a real shame because at first, the staff were incredibly competent, and above all, it was clear they loved what they did.

A couple of months ago, I ordered a bag of food to pick up (something I've always done there), and they charged me an exorbitant €40 more than the food was worth. Even so, I tried to convince myself it was just human error and continued taking my dog ​​for her routine.

This week I went back because of a cyst on my dog's ear (about 2mm, it's like a pimple). They sent me straight to surgery, with a quote of almost €400, and worst of all, full sedation! All this without giving me any prior explanation or an alternative.

You have no shame. I don't plan to return, and I hope the people in the neighborhood realize what you're doing.
Good veterinary clinic

I want to highlight Sara's professionalism and patience. I went with my injured dog, and she took excellent care of us throughout the entire process. And Rocío too!

Thank you so much! I highly recommend them!

I'll start by saying that my cat isn't an easy patient: he has a hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (which makes him more delicate when he's under anesthesia), he's a little overweight, and his mouth is complicated.
In this context, veterinarian Héctor Martín performed an echocardiogram, teeth cleaning, blood tests, X-rays, and (unfortunately) extracted a tooth that needed to be removed. He did all of this efficiently, quickly (he was home with me at lunchtime), and with the utmost care for my cat. With this level of service, I can't recommend this clinic highly enough.

I called to order some flea and tick pipettes. They answered the phone and told me the price, that they were in stock, and that I should come and get them even though my animals weren't registered. They said the registration process would …

I took my cat Amor to this clinic on October 1st because I lived next door, and I regretted my decision.
My cat was admitted because she had lost her appetite after moving from …
Great....Great..... Excellent treatment as always with our cats and the street cats😻❤😻😽😽😽😽 …

I had an emergency situation that I needed a health certificate for my dog in order to travel  to the U.S. in the next 2 days from Madrid. Dra. Beatriz Nieto Rodríguez and her team guided me through the whole process seamlessly! They went …

Very nice, attentive, and well-trained vets. It's so hard to find professionals like them. They treat animals with all the love in the world and are very up-to-date. My dog ​​left thrilled after her check-up and blood work. 10/10
P.S.: They have Vaccichek!
